From Cheap Trick · Price: your stand must touch the target's back.

Theme Mind and Sense

  • 1: 1 action: your stand rides a creature's back unseen (@Check[reflex|against:stand]{Reflex} negates); you hear what it hears, and the creature takes –2 to attack rolls against your stand while it rides.
  • 5: Surge: the stand whispers to it (@Check[will|against:stand]{Will}): @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 1} on a success, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 2} on a failure, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened 3} on a critical failure.
  • 9: It can't see your stand at all.
  • 13: While the stand rides, the creature can't reduce its @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{frightened} value below 1.
  • 17: The stand makes it drop @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} (@Check[fortitude|against:stand]{Fortitude} negates).

Effects @UUID[Compendium.pf2e-stand-class-archetype.stand-effects.Item.qxGSykRFrJuQp5D0]{Effect: Back Rider}

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
